test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only six people sit to the right of C. Only four people sit to the left of B. D sits to the left of A but right of B. F sits second to the right of G. How many people sit to the right of E?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. Only six people sit to the right of C.

2. Only four people sit to the left of B.

3. D sits to the left of A but right of B.

4. F sits second to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/600ce00976ebe4f6a68d131446cc2c241340395e324562ecd478e94f0238b698.png] 

E, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed4c678113aece7cee753b367f93d683da653ef48195a1c72a4cfc152e72bd20.png] 

Thus, four people sit to the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
